steps.text: Ray block: Fenwick can only be at r1c1 or r1c9, and those tiles all lie on one sightline. Whichever one Fenwick takes, the whole stretch is watched, so nobody else can stand on the marked tiles.
Jules was the only person beside a lamppost, so no other suspect (and not S. H. Adow) can be beside any lamppost.

Horace was alone in the area, but Fenwick must be in the Pool Hall, Gilbert must be in the Laundromat, Emil must be at the Bus Stop, Ingrid must be in the Alleyway and Jules must be in the Courtyard, so Horace cannot be in any of them.
Alice was west of Fenwick. Alice is in column 6 at the earliest, so Fenwick must be in columns 7–9.
Fenwick “was in the Pool Hall and was in a corner”: of the 2 tiles that fit, only r1c9 is still open. Place Fenwick there.
Horace was alone and can only be in the Diner, so nobody else can be in the Diner.
Beatrice was exactly one row south of Ingrid. Ingrid can only be in rows 3, 5, 6 or 7, which leaves Beatrice rows 4, 6, 7 or 8.
Emil was south of Gilbert. Emil can reach row 4 at most, so Gilbert must be in rows 1–3; Gilbert is in row 3 at the earliest, so Emil must be in rows 4–9.
Emil “was beside an advertising column and was south of Gilbert”: of the 2 tiles that fit, only r4c6 is still open. Place Emil there.
Ray block: Gilbert can only be at r3c2 or r3c3, and those tiles all lie on one sightline. Whichever one Gilbert takes, the whole stretch is watched, so nobody else can stand on the marked tiles.
Ray block: Alice can only be at r6c6, r7c6 or r8c6, and those tiles all lie on one sightline. Whichever one Alice takes, the whole stretch is watched, so nobody else can stand on the marked tiles.
Jules was east of Dolores. Jules can reach column 5 at most, so Dolores must be in columns 1–4.
Cecily was in the same area as Emil, so both must be in an area they can both still reach (Bus Stop).
Cecily “was in the same area as Emil”: every tile that fits is ruled out except r3c7. Place Cecily there.
Ray block: Ingrid can only be at r5c8, r6c8 or r7c8, and those tiles all lie on one sightline. Whichever one Ingrid takes, the whole stretch is watched, so nobody else can stand on r6c8, r7c8, r8c8.
Beatrice was exactly one row south of Ingrid. Ingrid can only be in rows 5–7, which leaves Beatrice rows 6–8.
Exactly one person was on a chair. Someone still has to stand on r8c1 or r9c2, and every one of those tiles watches r8c2, so nobody can stand there.
The blindspot law: r6c4 cannot be a hiding spot (Jules was the only person beside a lamppost), so someone must watch it. Only Jules can still see it, so Jules must stand on r6c4.
Jules “was the only person beside a lamppost and was east of Dolores”: of the 2 tiles that fit, only r6c4 is still open. Place Jules there.
The blindspot law: r9c1 cannot be a hiding spot (Horace was alone in the Diner), so someone must watch it. Only Horace can still see it, so Horace must stand on the marked tiles.
The blindspot law: r9c9 cannot be a hiding spot (Horace was alone in the Diner), so someone must watch it. Only Beatrice can still see it, so Beatrice must stand on r8c9.
Beatrice “was exactly one row south of Ingrid”: every tile that fits is ruled out except r8c9. Place Beatrice there.
Exactly one person was on a chair. Only Horace can still reach a chair, so he must be on one.
Horace “was alone”: every tile that fits is ruled out except r9c2. Place Horace there.

Gilbert “was in the same area as the Corpse and stood on bare pavement (no bench, chair, manhole cover, patch of broken glass, puddle, steam grate, trail of footprints or trapdoor)”: every tile that fits is ruled out except r3c3. Place Gilbert there.
Dolores “was in front of a doorway”: every tile that fits is ruled out except r2c1. Place Dolores there.
Beatrice was exactly one row south of Ingrid. Beatrice can only be in row 8, which leaves Ingrid row 7.
Ingrid “was in the Alleyway”: of the 4 tiles that fit, only r7c8 is still open. Place Ingrid there.
The blindspot law: r7c5 cannot be a hiding spot (Jules was the only person beside a lamppost), so someone must watch it. Only Alice can still see it, so Alice must stand on r7c6.
Alice “was in column 6 and was west of Fenwick”: of the 6 tiles that fit, only r7c6 is still open. Place Alice there.
Every suspect is placed and no two of them see each other. Exactly one open tile is still dark: r4c4. That is where S. H. Adow is hiding!
